g.text: Your back catalogue is the real dependency,
and we do not yet have a technical answer for it.

You raised this directly last round: the effort of going back through historic assets that were never catalogued properly. It is a fair challenge, it cannot be handed to a discovery workshop, and this is the
YOUR DAM TODAY · HISTORIC BACK CATALOGUE
Orderable from the moment it is made.
grows with every brief, from day one
THREE CANDIDATE RESPONSES · NONE OF THESE IS AGREED, COSTED OR COMMITTED
AI tasks read the existing files and write back component breakdowns, tags and usage
Nobody in the discussion could confirm this is technically possible at the
quality needed. Do not present it as available.
A named person assigned to organise, describe and maintain the back catalogue.
Offered on a previous pitch as a chargeable resource. If we propose it here,
somebody has to cost it first.
Nothing is touched until an asset is actually ordered. It is described at the point of reuse,
Included here because it is the only option that needs neither a technical
proof nor a new cost line.
We owe a technical response, and it has to be ours.
Whichever option we choose, saying “we will work that out in discovery” repeats the answer that already did not land. Pick one, say what it costs them, and say what we will prove
TECHNOLOGY SECTION · STORYBOARD FOR NARRATIVE AGREEMENT
